jobs.title: Senior Director of Product, Mobile
jobs.description:
Sr Director of Product, Mobile

Squarespace is looking for a Senior Director of Product, Mobile to own product strategy for our mobile experience as it evolves from a companion to desktop into a primary growth channel for the business. Sellers increasingly run their businesses from their phones, taking payments in person, sending invoices, and managing orders on the go, and mobile is now one of the highest-leverage growth surfaces at the company.

This is a surface-level mandate, not just an app role. Today our mobile experience spans a native app, mobile web, and product experiences designed desktop-first and adapted for mobile with varying consistency. You will unify this into one coherent mobile strategy: deciding where the native app, mobile web, and responsive experiences each play, and ensuring every new product experience treats mobile as a first-class consideration.

You will lead and develop the mobile product team across our US and Dublin squads, partner as a true peer with mobile engineering, design, and analytics, and represent mobile in company-level product planning as our product architecture evolves. You will report to Squarespace’s President and work from our New York City office (hybrid 3x/week).

You’ll Get To…

- Own the multi-year mobile strategy across the native app, mobile web, and adapted product experiences, aligning executive stakeholders on the north star, target customers, and investment sequencing

- Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers across two geographies, building a high-performing mobile product function

- Drive measurable business outcomes in seller activation, engagement, and revenue through mobile product decisions

- Define mobile-native experiences that leverage mobile-specific capabilities including in-person payments, real-time notifications, camera, and on-the-go workflows

- Ensure new product experiences across the company are adapted for mobile with quality and consistency

- Shape how mobile fits into the future of Squarespace's product architecture, with a seat at the table as that architecture evolves

Who We’re Looking For

- 12+ years of product management experience including leading and developing PM teams at the Director level or above

- Owned mobile as a surface strategy, spanning native apps and mobile web.

- You have shipped experiences where mobile was a critical product for the business and there was a high bar for your organization’s mobile craft

- You carry a track record of outcome ownership, including activation, engagement, or revenue results you drove and the product choices behind them

- Experience in commerce, payments, or seller/SMB tools strongly preferred

- Fluency in mobile-native product mechanics

- Comfortable operating amid evolving product and organizational architecture. You have experience influencing decisions beyond your direct scope.

Benefits & Perks

- A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision

- Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans

- Fertility and adoption benefits

- Headspace mindfulness app subscription

- Global Employee Assistance Program

- Retirement benefits with employer match

- Flexible paid time off

- 12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave

- Pretax commuter benefit

- Education reimbursement

- Employee donation match to community organizations

- 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

- Dog-friendly workplace

- Free lunch and snacks

- Private rooftop

- Hack week twice per year

Cash Compensation Range: $323,000 - $435,000 USD

The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.

In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.

About Squarespace

Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers .

jobs.title: Senior Product Director, Client Engagement Group
jobs.description:
At Squarespace, we empower our product teams to solve hard problems in ways that our customers love and strengthen our business. As Senior Director of Product for the Client Engagement Group (CEG), you will lead the product strategy and execution for Squarespace's customer engagement platform: the CRM, email campaigns, automations, and transactional communications that enable our merchants to build lasting customer relationships and grow their businesses on Squarespace.

The Client Engagement Group sits at the center of Squarespace's growth strategy. Our marketing tools are a critical lever in increasing product attach, reducing merchant churn, and building a differentiated position in the service commerce landscape. You will own the vision for transforming our current communications offering into a unified customer engagement hub… one that competes with best-in-class tools while leveraging Squarespace's unique data and ecosystem advantages.

You will report directly to the President of Squarespace and serve as a member of the Product leadership team. You will have the option of working on-site (hybrid) at our NYC headquarters or remotely within the U.S.

You’ll Get To…

- Define and drive the multi-year product vision and strategy for CEG - spanning CRM, email campaigns, automations, transactional communications, and emerging channels including SMS - with a clear line of sight to revenue growth and platform impact

- Own the Email Campaigns business line end-to-end: report on revenue performance, develop engagement and GTM strategies, and lead roadmap decisions in close partnership with commercial and marketing stakeholders

- Build toward a competitive, full-featured customer engagement platform by prioritizing investments in business CRM, transactional automations, flexible communication channels, and advanced segmentation that meet the sophisticated needs of today's service sellers

- Lead, grow, and mentor a team of product managers across multiple product lines, setting a high bar for hypothesis-driven development, roadmap rigor, and customer-centricity

- Partner with Engineering and Design functional leads to deliver outcomes across the team; step in to remove blockers and maintain velocity on high-priority initiatives

- Collaborate across the Squarespace ecosystem - with Commerce, Growth, Financial Solutions, and GTM - to ensure CEG products are deeply integrated into the broader platform

- Champion the use of Squarespace data and AI to create smarter automation flows, personalized outreach, and differentiated customer engagement experiences that competitors cannot easily replicate

- Shape the process, craft, and standards for senior product leadership at Squarespace

Who We’re Looking For

- 12+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent building and scaling customer engagement, CRM, marketing, or communications products

- 5+ years leading and developing teams of product managers in complex, multi-product environments

- Deep familiarity with the customer engagement and email service provider landscape; informed perspective on what it takes to compete with and differentiate from best-in-class marketing and CRM tools

- Demonstrated ability to own a revenue-generating product line with accountability for business outcomes, not just product delivery

- Strong strategic instincts paired with a bias for execution; comfortable operating at the intersection of vision-setting and unblocking day-to-day team work

- Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner with the credibility to influence senior leadership and align stakeholders across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing functions

- Experience applying hypothesis-driven development and experimentation to accelerate product-market fit and grow adoption

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Acuity Scheduling, Payments
jobs.description:
At Squarespace, we empower product teams to solve meaningful customer and business problems. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Acuity Scheduling team, leading product management across Acuity's payments and mobile surfaces for one of Squarespace's core scheduling products.

Acuity Scheduling helps service businesses run their operations end-to-end: booking, client management, and getting paid. Payments is central to that value proposition, and it's one of Acuity's most significant growth opportunities. This role owns the strategy and execution for expanding how and where Acuity sellers collect revenue, building the payment experiences, defaults, and integrations that make on-platform collection the obvious choice across web, mobile, and emerging booking channels.

This is a hybrid role, requiring 1–3 days a week in our New York City office. You will report to the Product Director on the Acuity Scheduling team.

You'll Get To...

- Own the long-term strategy and roadmap for payments, transactions, and mobile on Acuity

- Lead rigorous problem discovery, deeply understanding customer, business, and market dynamics before pursuing major investments

- Develop evidence-based problem statements grounded in user research, competitive analysis, and financial data

- Define target segments, primary use cases, and expansion opportunities across web, mobile, and in-person payment contexts

- Balance partner, build, buy, and deprecate decisions to accelerate GPV growth and customer impact

- Drive payment integrations and checkout UX across Acuity's web and mobile surfaces

- Leverage relationships with external partners to address areas of opportunity where Acuity can serve customers in a distinctive way

- Partner with marketing to launch new products, with customer operations to develop excellent merchant support, and with analytics to monitor engagement and evaluate success

- Own the key metrics for your business area, explain trends, and build shared understanding across teams and stakeholders

- Create alignment across stakeholders through clear narratives, documentation, and prioritization frameworks

Who We're Looking For

- 6–8+ years of product management experience in SaaS or consumer software, with a track record of shipping products that drive measurable business outcomes

- Deep experience with payments, fintech, or transaction products, including third-party integrations, checkout UX, and payment infrastructure

- Experience leading mobile product development across iOS and Android surfaces

- Strong data and financial analysis skills, with experience sizing opportunities and validating demand

- High technical fluency; comfortable partnering on complex workflows, data models, and platform integrations

- Proven ability to define the right problem before designing solutions, resistant to premature solutioning

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams around business goals

- Customer-obsessed, with a history of conducting research, customer interviews, and usability testing to inform decisions

- Comfortable challenging default approaches when they conflict with user or commercial outcomes

Nice to Have

- Experience with in-person payments, POS integrations, or hardware-adjacent product work

- Familiarity with scheduling, booking, or operational tools for SMBs
